mitigations.benign: None. Message represents legitimate routine personal or administrative operational communication.
mitigations.blackmail_coercion: Do not succumb to coercion or provide military documents. Disconnect and report immediately to Counter-Intelligence.
mitigations.honey_trapping: Terminate contact immediately. Do not share rank, unit, photos of post, or movement. Preserve handle & report to Unit Security Officer.
mitigations.malicious_dropper: Do not download external APKs, SCR, or double-extension files. Official military software is distributed strictly through authorized intranet.
mitigations.military_spear_phishing: Do not open unverified URLs or enter service numbers/OTP. Verify directly via official .gov.in/.nic.in portals.
mitigations.opsec_reconnaissance: Refuse disclosure of equipment, movement, or strength. Flag inquiry to Military Intelligence (MI).
